mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_MES_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC a USING ( SELECT PRODUCT_DATE, CX_MACHINE_CODE, SAP_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION, REMARK, nvl(UPDATE_DATE, CREATE_DATE) CREATE_TIME FROM T_MES_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC WHERE data_version = #{dataVersion} ) b ON ( a.PRODUCT_DATE = b.PRODUCT_DATE AND b.CX_MACHINE_CODE = a.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND a.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.EMBRYO_CODE = b.EMBRYO_CODE, a.SAP_CODE = b.SAP_CODE, a.BOM_DATA_VERSION = b.BOM_DATA_VERSION, a.REMARK = b.REMARK, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.CREATE_TIME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.id, a.PRODUCT_DATE, a.CX_MACHINE_CODE, a.SAP_CODE,a.embryo_code, a.bom_data_version, a.remark, a.create_time, a.del_flag) VALUES (SEQ_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC.NEXTVAL, b.PRODUCT_DATE, b.CX_MACHINE_CODE, b.SAP_CODE, b.embryo_code, b.bom_data_version, b.remark, b.create_time, '0')
